name: Advanced Reconstruction
oracle_text:
(Gain the next level as a sorcery to add its ability.)
At the beginning of your first main phase, mill a card, then exile a card from your graveyard at random. You may play the exiled card this turn.
{1}{R}: Level 2
Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, this Class deals 2 damage to each opponent.
{1}{R}: Level 3
Spells you cast from anywhere other than your hand cost {2} less to cast.
blocked_sentences: Spells you cast from anywhere other than your hand cost {2} less to cast.

needs.what: a spell_cost_reduction static whose affects_spells can filter on the zone the spell is being cast from, e.g. except_zones: ["hand"] (or zones: ["graveyard", "exile", "library", "command"]), so "spells you cast from anywhere other than your hand cost {2} less" discounts graveyard, exile, library-top and command-zone casts but not hand casts
needs.why_existing_wont_do: spell_cost_reduction (player_statics.spell_cost_reduction) is handed only a CardDef and matches affects_spells against the printed face via _matches_printed; it never sees the zone the spell is cast from, and affects_spells has no zones/except_zones key. except_zones exists only on cant_cast_spells_from_zones, which forbids rather than discounts. A plain spell_cost_reduction with no zone filter would also discount hand casts, which is a different card
